title: Chapter 551 - 551 Hello, Sister Xinyue; Apologize!
content:
Chapter 551 - 551 Hello, Sister Xinyue; Apologize!

Chapter 551 - 551 Hello, Sister Xinyue; Apologize!

551 Hello, Sister Xinyue; Apologize!

This man was Liu Yuhang, whom he had not seen for a long time!

Back then, after the mountain road race, Liu Yuhang began to get close to Lin Fan.

Later on, when he brought Lin Fan to the capital to attend the auction, Lin Fan casually saved Old Master Zhou.

Liu Yuhang was shocked by Lin Fan.

When Lin Fan used his amazing financial methods to easily earn 400% profit in the stock market in just three days, Liu Yuhang started to worship him even more.

Not too long ago, Lin Fan offered to sell the drug to the Liu and Sun families. Liu Yuhang was extremely grateful.

In the beginning, he only wanted to be on good terms with Lin Fan.

However, later on, Liu Yuhang completely treated himself as Lin Fan’s lackey.

How could a lackey not be excited when he saw his big brother?

Wang Tong was stunned.

Liu Yuhang had walked out of a Lamborghini.

He actually knew Lin Fan?

His tone was so respectful too!

Respectful?

A rich young master who drove a Lamborghini was respectful to a loser?

What was going on?

In contrast to Wang Tong’s confusion, Tan Jiayou’s heart was beating wildly.

He knew… Or rather, he had seen Liu Yuhang before!

It was at a dinner party not long ago…

When Liu Yuhang arrived at the banquet venue, he immediately became the most dazzling presence.

Everyone hurriedly went forward to ask about his well-being and smiled apologetically.

Tan Jiayou’s father, on the other hand, was so happy that he could not sleep for a few nights because Liu Yuhang had a drink with him.

Later, his father told Tan Jiayou that Liu Yuhang was the young master of Liu Pharmaceuticals!

What kind of existence was Liu Pharmaceuticals?

Before this year, Liu Pharmaceuticals was a giant enterprise in the entire Jiang Province!

This year, Liu Pharmaceuticals and Sun Pharmaceuticals obtained the total sales rights of the human islet recovery drug.

This led to the expansion of Liu and Sun Pharmaceuticals. They had the potential to become the top pharmaceutical companies in the country.

As the young master of Liu Pharmaceuticals, Liu Yuhang was like a person sitting on top of the clouds!

Such an existence had actually appeared in front of him.

Moreover, he even addressed this ordinary-looking young man as Brother Lin Fan?

This…

He must have misheard! That was it!

Lin Fan was a little surprised. “Yuhang, long time no see. What have you been busy with recently?”

Liu Yuhang smiled. “Brother Lin Fan, ever since you gave the task of developing the human islet recovery drug to my family and the Sun family, I’ve been helping my family expand the market.”

Tan Jiayou was shocked!

He did not hear wrongly!

Liu Yuhang was really calling him Brother Lin Fan!

Moreover, from what Liu Yuhang said, the reason why Liu Pharmaceuticals and Sun Pharmaceuticals were able to sell the human islet recovery drug was all because of Lin Fan?

Who exactly was this young man?

He had just said that he wanted the other party to work in his father’s company and give him double his salary.

Also, Li Xinyue seemed to be Lin Fan’s girlfriend.

He had also repeatedly expressed his desire for Li Xinyue.

This… This…

Tan Jiayou’s face turned pale at the thought of this, and a thin layer of sweat gradually seeped out of his forehead.

He understood that he had caused trouble.

It was a disaster!

Lin Fan did not care about Tan Jiayou’s change of heart. He continued to chat and laugh with Liu Yuhang.

“You bastard, it seems that you’re blaming me for giving your family and the Sun family the opportunity to sell the drug, which is why you don’t have time to fool around anymore.”

Liu Yuhang said, “Of course not! I’m so happy!

“It’s because you let our family sell the drug that I have the simple task of expanding the market. I completed it quickly, and my family even gave me a lot of bonuses.

“With this money, I can make better modifications to my car!”

Liu Yuhang’s eyes lit up at the mention of car modification. He was extremely excited.

He loved cars from the bottom of his heart.

Looking at how serious he was, Lin Fan could not help but burst out laughing.

Then, Lin Fan introduced, “Oh right. This is my junior, Li Xinyue.”

What kind of foresight did Liu Yuhang have?

He easily noticed that Li Xinyue was exquisite and beautiful. Furthermore, the way she looked at Lin Fan was filled with love.

“Sister Xinyue!” Liu Yuhang said. “Hello, Xinyue.”

Liu Yuhang was several years older than Li Xinyue.

However, he called her ‘Sister Xinyue.’

Li Xinyue’s pretty face instantly flushed red.

She understood what this title meant.

Liu Yuhang had just called Lin Fan ‘Brother Fan’!

Li Xinyue was both shy and happy.

Liu Yuhang turned around and opened the trunk to the Lamborghini. He took out a suet jade bracelet and said, “Sister Xinyue, I left in a hurry today and didn’t bring any gifts. I hope you don’t mind this bracelet.”

Li Xinyue did not like to accept gifts from others.

Especially guys.

However, this was a gift from Lin Fan’s friend.

Moreover, the other party even called her ‘Sister Xinyue.’

If she did not accept it, would Lin Fan have other thoughts?

Li Xinyue hesitated for a while but still reached out and said, “Thank you…”

“You’re too kind, Sister Xinyue.” Liu Yuhang laughed heartily.”

It had to be said that Liu Yuhang had good communication skills.

With just a few words, he easily got close to Li Xinyue.

At this moment, Lin Fan seemed to have thought of something. He turned to Tan Jiayou and said, “By the way, you just said that as long as I want to do business, you can transfer the money to me immediately, right? Then let’s do it. Transfer ten billion first.”

Ten billion?

Even if Tan Jiayu sold the entire Tan family, he would not be able to gather that much money.

Tan Jiayou understood that Lin Fan was deliberately making things difficult for him and punishing him.

Therefore, he said in a mournful tone, “M-Mr. Lin, I’m sorry. I was blind earlier. I’m sorry…”

Lin Fan said, “What do you mean? Didn’t you say that your family’s Waffle Corporation is going public soon? Aren’t you a department manager at Maple Leaf Ventures? Didn’t you just agree to loan me money? It’s just ten billion.”

Tan Jiayou was about to cry. He said in a panic, “Mr. Lin, I’m sorry, I’m sorry… I won’t pester Li Xinyue anymore. I’m sorry…”

“Hmph!” Lin Fan grunted.

Liu Yuhang was pretty smart.

With just a few simple sentences, he easily knew the general process of the matter.

Perhaps Tan Jiayou saw Li Xinyue’s beauty and began to show off his strength to win her admiration.

He was lusting for Lin Fan’s woman, and it was in front of Lin Fan!

What a bastard!

Liu Yuhang’s face darkened. “Waffle Corporation? The chairman’s surname is Tan, right? It seems that this company has been developing too smoothly.”

Tan Jiayou’s body trembled, and he said in panic,” Young Master Liu, please have mercy. Mr. Lin, Young Master Liu… I’m sorry, I’m sorry…”
